messages.zoom.connection.auth-help: Use a Zoom OAuth user access token. The identity check calls /v2/users/me. Server-to-Server account tokens cannot access /users/me and fail the live check, so use a token with user context.
messages.zoom.guide.token-note: Use a Zoom OAuth user access token and replace it when it expires.
messages.zoom.oauth.note: Enable read access to users, meetings and recordings in the Zoom app.
